questions.question: The most common type of breech presentation is:
questions.explanation: Frank breech is the most common type (~60-70%), with hips flexed and knees extended so feet are near the head.

explanations.C: Footling breech (one or both feet presenting) is less common and high-risk for cord prolapse.
explanations.D: Kneeling breech is the rarest variant.
